reels.label: Reel covers
reels.rule: A striking, clear subject with a composition that would work as a Reel cover, especially in portrait orientation.

reels.label: Photo inserts
reels.rule: Useful photos for cutaways, photo montages, product details, location context or before-and-after stories.

reels.label: Other photos
reels.rule: Catch-all for photos and screenshots without a clear Reel use.

reels.label: Hooks and talking clips
reels.rule: A prominent person facing the camera, expressive reaction, or immediate attention-grabbing action. Prefer short portrait clips.

reels.label: Vertical B-roll
reels.rule: Portrait footage for a Reel cutaway, showing a place, detail, activity, product or movement.

reels.label: Clips to reframe
reels.rule: Landscape or square footage with a strong central subject that could work cropped for a vertical Reel.

reels.label: Other clips
reels.rule: Catch-all for footage without a clear Reel use, including basic screen recordings and ambiguous frames.

cinematic.label: Editorial stills
cinematic.rule: Well-composed stills that work as visual inserts or frames for the edit.

cinematic.label: Reference and continuity
cinematic.rule: Behind-the-scenes, lighting, wardrobe, props and location references, or production notes.

cinematic.label: Other photos
cinematic.rule: Catch-all for photos without a clear production or editing use.

cinematic.label: Establishing shots
cinematic.rule: Wide shots that introduce a location, scene or environment. Landscape framing often suits this folder.

cinematic.label: Action and performance
cinematic.rule: A main subject performing, speaking on camera, or doing a recognizable action. Judge by visible cues.

cinematic.label: B-roll and details
cinematic.rule: Close-ups, textures, objects, inserts and atmosphere that could support a scene.

cinematic.label: Other footage
cinematic.rule: Catch-all for miscellaneous footage, screen recordings or clips with unclear editing use.
